catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class starts all systems of an instrument mainframe. cap.process.run.v1 declares process.controller and requires a recipe_ref; cap.motion.stop.v1 is motion-specific. The action sends the native RST 1 and reports the run state read back through the native is_running Feat.

No catalogue class stops an instrument's acquisition systems. cap.motion.stop.v1 declares robot.arm, robot.mobile_base and motion.axis and takes a motion deceleration; its effect is motion.joint. The action sends the native RST 0 (the safe state) and reports the run state read back.

No catalogue class resets an instrument to its factory default power-up state. cap.world.reset.v1 declares world.sim; cap.device.self_test.v1 runs a self-test; cap.device.calibrate.v1 calibrates. The action sends the native *RST and reports the run state read back.

No catalogue class clears one measurement's accumulated results. cap.measure.voltage.v1, cap.measure.current.v1 and cap.measure.temperature.v1 are read classes over instrument.dmm, instrument.smu, sensor or instrument.thermometer; cap.device.calibrate.v1 calibrates. The action sends the native DET:RRES and reports the cleared bit and error counts.

notes:
Passed on the fake backend by `python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/labs/sfinucane__sindri --backend fake`; evidence is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. The package binds the card's first AST-confirmed entry symbol, `sindri.tektronix.bertscope:BERTScope_TCP`; the other four entry symbols in the clone (`E3631A_TCP`, `N77XX_TCP`, `N77XX_USBVisa`, `DSOX92504A_TCP`) are separate instruments and are not served by this package. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card names the PythonObjectDriver helper, but a python-object command binds one native method and requires a non-empty result map; the run, stop and factory-reset actions call the native command and then read the native is_running Feat back, so a decorated direct Driver is used, as the card's direct-driver decision allows. Covered: identity; internal temperature; the mainframe run state and run duration; the detector bit count, error count, bit error rate, elapsed time, resync count and error-free bit/time; the run-duration write (limit 0 to 36E6 s from sindri/tektronix/bertscope.py:184); run, stop (also the safe-state action), factory reset and detector-result reset; the e-stop calls the native stop (RST 0). NOT COVERED: the upstream status registers and settings (event_status_reg, set_operation_complete_bit, status_byte, service_request_enabled, event_status_enabled, clear_status, wait, wait_operation_complete_bit, scpi_version, io_min_delta, view, gui_lockout_enabled, detector_data_delay, detector_ber_display_mode, detector_update_interval, detector_delay_needs_recalibration, generator_delay_needs_recalibration, detector_auto_align); event_status_reg is a Feat with only a setter and no getter (bertscope.py:94-102) and set_operation_complete_bit sends *OPC through query() (bertscope.py:138-146), so neither is exposed. The fake is an in-memory stand-in (the clone has no simulator), not a transcript; it returns plain magnitudes instead of the upstream pint Quantities and every starting value is marked `# placeholder`. There is no waveform, image or array function in the served BERTScope surface. The hardware path (native.py, a lantz TCPDriver with host and port) was never imported or run; nothing here ran on an instrument. The package is R1 and model-authored and unreviewed (reviewed_by null): at R1 the loader does not mechanically refuse its hardware backend (that rule applies to model-authored R2/R3 packages), so do not start it until a human reviews it. No independent hardware e-stop is documented in the clone; the runtime stop and the safe-state action are the native stop() (RST 0). check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run; gate.digest is the digest the check printed.
